# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

The repository uses [.github/workflows/ci.yml](workflows/ci.yml) as the release-tag gate and [.github/workflows/coding-native.yml](workflows/coding-native.yml) as the opt-in native build workflow (manual dispatch or `coding-v*` tags). `ci.yml` runs after a `v<version>` release tag such as `v0.0.1` is pushed, on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runners, and must stay credential-free: do not add API keys, publishing tokens, self-hosted runner labels, or deployment steps to either workflow. Keep real-provider tests out of CI; the native workflow builds the macOS arm64 Electron app and Linux amd64 CLI/SEA runtime without publishing artifacts.
